faqs.question: What services does Yasir offer?
faqs.answer: AI solutions, AI chatbots and agents, web development, UI/UX, Figma, graphic design, posters, thumbnails, digital marketing, content writing and project guidance.

faqs.question: Can Yasir build a complete website?
faqs.answer: Yes. The service can include frontend and backend development, responsive layouts and deployment guidance.

faqs.question: Can Yasir build AI chatbots and AI agents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your use case, knowledge sources and required integrations through a service request.

faqs.question: What technologies does Yasir use?
faqs.answer: Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React are part of the toolkit, alongside Figma, Canva, GitHub, VS Code, Jupyter Notebook and Google Colab.

faqs.question: How does portfolio pricing work?
faqs.answer: Portfolio examples: Basic $80 for 1 page, 3 days and 1 revision; Standard $150 for 4 pages, 5 days and 2 revisions; Premium $250 for 7 pages, 7 days and 3 revisions. Other services require a custom quote.

faqs.question: Can I request a custom project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Request a Service, choose the closest service or Custom project, and describe your requirements.

faqs.question: How do I submit a service request?
faqs.answer: Open a service page, select Request This Service and complete the form. The chosen service is filled in automatically.

faqs.question: Where can I see Yasir’s work?
faqs.answer: Open the Work section to see live projects including TruthTrail, SmartCV AI, LanguageBridge, KIU Research Hub, KIU Research Intelligence Lab, HCI Learning Lab, HunarGah, Hunza Heritage and CraveBite. Every project has a live link.
